headline: “ODOO IS FREE”
IS ONLY

blocks.text: Odoo is free, so our ERP costs nothing.

items: **Community** is open source. **Enterprise** is a paid subscription per user.
Apps many SMEs need, like **full Accounting**, come with **Enterprise**.
Budget for **setup, data migration and training**, not just licences.
